References / Illustration / 172

Evolution (Daniel Oliva Barbero)

A textbook vaporwave collage: two cyan statues, an Ionic column carrying a glitched Windows logo, a pink Paint window, palms, a striped sun, and a pink grid over blue.

Source
Wikimedia Commons: Vaprwave 97346.png
Creator
Daniel Oliva Barbero
Made
August 6, 2019 (date given on Commons)
Style
Vaporwave (agent-proposed, not yet reviewed by a person)
Moods
Nostalgic, ironic, kitsch
Evidence
Inspected a 1920 × 2560 rendering of the 8554 × 11405 file on Wikimedia Commons, in a scratchpad copy. Not stored.
Reviewed
28 September 2026
Rights
Link and metadata only. License: unverified. Rights policy

Context

Commons lists it under CC BY 2.0 from Flickr, while the author’s description says CC BY 4.0 and that it was “created from” another Flickr work. Wikimedia Commons.

Observed

  • A mauve sky frames a yellow-to-pink sun cut by horizontal pink stripes.
  • A pink-tinted Microsoft Paint window with a navy title bar, tool palette, and colour swatches overlaps the left side.
  • A cyan Ionic capital and column carry a glitched, pixelated Windows flag logo in the centre.
  • Two identical cyan-and-violet statues of a draped woman face each other, each holding a small hexagonal pattern.
  • Pale pink palm trees stand at both sides; a magenta grid floor on blue recedes to the horizon.

Why it belongs

The most complete single statement of the rubric found in open sources. It is also a warning: the style depends on quoting other people’s trademarks and interfaces.

Borrow

Tint real classical figures in a single pastel duotone so they read as cut-outs rather than photographs.
